name: redteam_13_4
comment: Red team 13_4 (dead_end_after_turn, aimed at #13,#14,#1): Walking in echelon_right beside a left-side free wall, the squad turns left straight into that wall 3.8 m after the turn. The re-slotting into the wall layout happens mid-turn, so the rear and flank coverage of check 14 and the 6 m ring coverage at the wall end of check 13 may lapse. Broke 5 (check, choice, members): #3 flicker, #5 slots / spacing, #14 covered approach to the wall. First: #3 auto n2 R1 s1 t=16.3s - wall -> wedge, back after 0 s.
